3154// Formats a countable noun. Depending on its quantity, either the
3155// singular form or the plural form is used. e.g.
3156//
3157// FormatCountableNoun(1, "formula", "formuli") returns "1 formula".
3158// FormatCountableNoun(5, "book", "books") returns "5 books".
3159static std::string FormatCountableNoun(int count, const char* singular_form,
3160 const char* plural_form) {
3161 return internal::StreamableToString(count) + " " +
3162 (count == 1 ? singular_form : plural_form);
3163}
3164
3165// Formats the count of tests.
3166static std::string FormatTestCount(int test_count) {
3167 return FormatCountableNoun(test_count, "test", "tests");
3168}
3169
3170// Formats the count of test suites.
3171static std::string FormatTestSuiteCount(int test_suite_count) {
3172 return FormatCountableNoun(test_suite_count, "test suite", "test suites");
3173}
3174
3175// Converts a TestPartResult::Type enum to human-friendly string
3176// representation. Both kNonFatalFailure and kFatalFailure are translated
3177// to "Failure", as the user usually doesn't care about the difference
3178// between the two when viewing the test result.
3179static const char* TestPartResultTypeToString(TestPartResult::Type type) {
3180 switch (type) {
3181 case TestPartResult::kSkip:
3182 return "Skipped\n";
3183 case TestPartResult::kSuccess:
3184 return "Success";
3185
3186 case TestPartResult::kNonFatalFailure:
3187 case TestPartResult::kFatalFailure:
3188#ifdef _MSC_VER
3189 return "error: ";
3190#else
3191 return "Failure\n";
3192#endif
3193 default:
3194 return "Unknown result type";
3195 }
3196}

3198namespace internal {
3199namespace {
3200enum class GTestColor { kDefault, kRed, kGreen, kYellow };
3201} // namespace
3202
3203// Prints a TestPartResult to an std::string.
3204static std::string PrintTestPartResultToString(
3205 const TestPartResult& test_part_result) {
3206 return (Message() << internal::FormatFileLocation(
3207 test_part_result.file_name(),
3208 test_part_result.line_number())
3209 << " "
3210 << TestPartResultTypeToString(test_part_result.type())
3211 << test_part_result.message())
3212 .GetString();
3213}
3214
3215// Prints a TestPartResult.
3216static void PrintTestPartResult(const TestPartResult& test_part_result) {
3217 const std::string& result = PrintTestPartResultToString(test_part_result);
3218 printf("%s\n", result.c_str());
3219 fflush(stdout);
3220 // If the test program runs in Visual Studio or a debugger, the
3221 // following statements add the test part result message to the Output
3222 // window such that the user can double-click on it to jump to the
3223 // corresponding source code location; otherwise they do nothing.
3224#if defined(GTEST_OS_WINDOWS) && !defined(GTEST_OS_WINDOWS_MOBILE)
3225 // We don't call OutputDebugString*() on Windows Mobile, as printing
3226 // to stdout is done by OutputDebugString() there already - we don't
3227 // want the same message printed twice.
3228 ::OutputDebugStringA(result.c_str());
3229 ::OutputDebugStringA("\n");
3230#endif
3231}
3232
3233// class PrettyUnitTestResultPrinter
3234#if defined(GTEST_OS_WINDOWS) && !defined(GTEST_OS_WINDOWS_MOBILE) && \
3235 !defined(GTEST_OS_WINDOWS_GAMES) && !defined(GTEST_OS_WINDOWS_PHONE) && \
3236 !defined(GTEST_OS_WINDOWS_RT) && !defined(GTEST_OS_WINDOWS_MINGW)
3237
3238// Returns the character attribute for the given color.
3239static WORD GetColorAttribute(GTestColor color) {
3240 switch (color) {
3241 case GTestColor::kRed:
3242 return FOREGROUND_RED;
3243 case GTestColor::kGreen:
3244 return FOREGROUND_GREEN;
3245 case GTestColor::kYellow:
3246 return FOREGROUND_RED | FOREGROUND_GREEN;
3247 default:
3248 return 0;
3249 }
3250}
3251
3252static int GetBitOffset(WORD color_mask) {
3253 if (color_mask == 0) return 0;
3254
3255 int bitOffset = 0;
3256 while ((color_mask & 1) == 0) {
3257 color_mask >>= 1;
3258 ++bitOffset;
3259 }
3260 return bitOffset;
3261}
3262
3263static WORD GetNewColor(GTestColor color, WORD old_color_attrs) {
3264 // Let's reuse the BG
3265 static const WORD background_mask = BACKGROUND_BLUE | BACKGROUND_GREEN |
3266 BACKGROUND_RED | BACKGROUND_INTENSITY;
3267 static const WORD foreground_mask = FOREGROUND_BLUE | FOREGROUND_GREEN |
3268 FOREGROUND_RED | FOREGROUND_INTENSITY;
3269 const WORD existing_bg = old_color_attrs & background_mask;
3270
3271 WORD new_color =
3272 GetColorAttribute(color) | existing_bg | FOREGROUND_INTENSITY;
3273 static const int bg_bitOffset = GetBitOffset(background_mask);
3274 static const int fg_bitOffset = GetBitOffset(foreground_mask);
3275
3276 if (((new_color & background_mask) >> bg_bitOffset) ==
3277 ((new_color & foreground_mask) >> fg_bitOffset)) {
3278 new_color ^= FOREGROUND_INTENSITY; // invert intensity
3279 }
3280 return new_color;
3281}
3282
3283#else
3284
3285// Returns the ANSI color code for the given color. GTestColor::kDefault is
3286// an invalid input.
3287static const char* GetAnsiColorCode(GTestColor color) {
3288 switch (color) {
3289 case GTestColor::kRed:
3290 return "1";
3291 case GTestColor::kGreen:
3292 return "2";
3293 case GTestColor::kYellow:
3294 return "3";
3295 default:
3296 assert(false);
3297 return "9";
3298 }
3299}
3300
3301#endif // GTEST_OS_WINDOWS && !GTEST_OS_WINDOWS_MOBILE
3302
3303// Returns true if and only if Google Test should use colors in the output.
3304bool ShouldUseColor(bool stdout_is_tty) {
3305 std::string c = GTEST_FLAG_GET(color);
3306 const char* const gtest_color = c.c_str();
3307
3308 if (String::CaseInsensitiveCStringEquals(gtest_color, "auto")) {
3309#if defined(GTEST_OS_WINDOWS) && !defined(GTEST_OS_WINDOWS_MINGW)
3310 // On Windows the TERM variable is usually not set, but the
3311 // console there does support colors.
3312 return stdout_is_tty;
3313#else
3314 // On non-Windows platforms, we rely on the TERM variable.
3315 const char* const term = posix::GetEnv("TERM");
3316 const bool term_supports_color =
3317 term != nullptr && (String::CStringEquals(term, "xterm") ||
3318 String::CStringEquals(term, "xterm-color") ||
3319 String::CStringEquals(term, "xterm-ghostty") ||
3320 String::CStringEquals(term, "xterm-kitty") ||
3321 String::CStringEquals(term, "alacritty") ||
3322 String::CStringEquals(term, "screen") ||
3323 String::CStringEquals(term, "tmux") ||
3324 String::CStringEquals(term, "rxvt-unicode") ||
3325 String::CStringEquals(term, "linux") ||
3326 String::CStringEquals(term, "cygwin") ||
3327 String::EndsWithCaseInsensitive(term, "-256color"));
3328 return stdout_is_tty && term_supports_color;
3329#endif // GTEST_OS_WINDOWS
3330 }
3331
3332 return String::CaseInsensitiveCStringEquals(gtest_color, "yes") ||
3333 String::CaseInsensitiveCStringEquals(gtest_color, "true") ||
3334 String::CaseInsensitiveCStringEquals(gtest_color, "t") ||
3335 String::CStringEquals(gtest_color, "1");
3336 // We take "yes", "true", "t", and "1" as meaning "yes". If the
3337 // value is neither one of these nor "auto", we treat it as "no" to
3338 // be conservative.
3339}
3340
3341// Helpers for printing colored strings to stdout. Note that on Windows, we
3342// cannot simply emit special characters and have the terminal change colors.
3343// This routine must actually emit the characters rather than return a string
3344// that would be colored when printed, as can be done on Linux.
3345
3346GTEST_ATTRIBUTE_PRINTF_(2, 3)
3347static void ColoredPrintf(GTestColor color, const char* fmt, ...) {
3348 va_list args;
3349 va_start(args, fmt);
3350
3351 static const bool in_color_mode =
3352 // We don't condition this on GTEST_HAS_FILE_SYSTEM because we still need
3353 // to be able to detect terminal I/O regardless.
3354 ShouldUseColor(posix::IsATTY(posix::FileNo(stdout)) != 0);
3355
3356 const bool use_color = in_color_mode && (color != GTestColor::kDefault);
3357
3358 if (!use_color) {
3359 vprintf(fmt, args);
3360 va_end(args);
3361 return;
3362 }
3363
3364#if defined(GTEST_OS_WINDOWS) && !defined(GTEST_OS_WINDOWS_MOBILE) && \
3365 !defined(GTEST_OS_WINDOWS_GAMES) && !defined(GTEST_OS_WINDOWS_PHONE) && \
3366 !defined(GTEST_OS_WINDOWS_RT) && !defined(GTEST_OS_WINDOWS_MINGW)
3367 const HANDLE stdout_handle = GetStdHandle(STD_OUTPUT_HANDLE);
3368
3369 // Gets the current text color.
3370 CONSOLE_SCREEN_BUFFER_INFO buffer_info;
3371 GetConsoleScreenBufferInfo(stdout_handle, &buffer_info);
3372 const WORD old_color_attrs = buffer_info.wAttributes;
3373 const WORD new_color = GetNewColor(color, old_color_attrs);
3374
3375 // We need to flush the stream buffers into the console before each
3376 // SetConsoleTextAttribute call lest it affect the text that is already
3377 // printed but has not yet reached the console.
3378 fflush(stdout);
3379 SetConsoleTextAttribute(stdout_handle, new_color);
3380
3381 vprintf(fmt, args);
3382
3383 fflush(stdout);
3384 // Restores the text color.
3385 SetConsoleTextAttribute(stdout_handle, old_color_attrs);
3386#else
3387 printf("\033[0;3%sm", GetAnsiColorCode(color));
3388 vprintf(fmt, args);
3389 printf("\033[m"); // Resets the terminal to default.
3390#endif // GTEST_OS_WINDOWS && !GTEST_OS_WINDOWS_MOBILE
3391 va_end(args);
3392}
3393
3394// Text printed in Google Test's text output and --gtest_list_tests
3395// output to label the type parameter and value parameter for a test.
3396static const char kTypeParamLabel[] = "TypeParam";
3397static const char kValueParamLabel[] = "GetParam()";
3398
3399static void PrintFullTestCommentIfPresent(const TestInfo& test_info) {
3400 const char* const type_param = test_info.type_param();
3401 const char* const value_param = test_info.value_param();
3402
3403 if (type_param != nullptr || value_param != nullptr) {
3404 printf(", where ");
3405 if (type_param != nullptr) {
3406 printf("%s = %s", kTypeParamLabel, type_param);
3407 if (value_param != nullptr) printf(" and ");
3408 }
3409 if (value_param != nullptr) {
3410 printf("%s = %s", kValueParamLabel, value_param);
3411 }
3412 }
3413}

3415// This class implements the TestEventListener interface.
3416//
3417// Class PrettyUnitTestResultPrinter is copyable.
3418class PrettyUnitTestResultPrinter : public TestEventListener {
3419 public:
3420 PrettyUnitTestResultPrinter() = default;
3421 static void PrintTestName(const char* test_suite, const char* test) {
3422 printf("%s.%s", test_suite, test);
3423 }
3424
3425 // The following methods override what's in the TestEventListener class.
3426 void OnTestProgramStart(const UnitTest& /*unit_test*/) override {}
3427 void OnTestIterationStart(const UnitTest& unit_test, int iteration) override;
3428 void OnEnvironmentsSetUpStart(const UnitTest& unit_test) override;
3429 void OnEnvironmentsSetUpEnd(const UnitTest& /*unit_test*/) override {}
3430#ifndef GTEST_REMOVE_LEGACY_TEST_CASEAPI_
3431 void OnTestCaseStart(const TestCase& test_case) override;
3432#else
3433 void OnTestSuiteStart(const TestSuite& test_suite) override;
3434#endif // OnTestCaseStart
3435
3436 void OnTestStart(const TestInfo& test_info) override;
3437 void OnTestDisabled(const TestInfo& test_info) override;
3438
3439 void OnTestPartResult(const TestPartResult& result) override;
3440 void OnTestEnd(const TestInfo& test_info) override;
3441#ifndef GTEST_REMOVE_LEGACY_TEST_CASEAPI_
3442 void OnTestCaseEnd(const TestCase& test_case) override;
3443#else
3444 void OnTestSuiteEnd(const TestSuite& test_suite) override;
3445#endif // GTEST_REMOVE_LEGACY_TEST_CASEAPI_
3446
3447 void OnEnvironmentsTearDownStart(const UnitTest& unit_test) override;
3448 void OnEnvironmentsTearDownEnd(const UnitTest& /*unit_test*/) override {}
3449 void OnTestIterationEnd(const UnitTest& unit_test, int iteration) override;
3450 void OnTestProgramEnd(const UnitTest& /*unit_test*/) override {}
3451
3452 private:
3453 static void PrintFailedTests(const UnitTest& unit_test);
3454 static void PrintFailedTestSuites(const UnitTest& unit_test);
3455 static void PrintSkippedTests(const UnitTest& unit_test);
3456};
3457
3458// Fired before each iteration of tests starts.
3459void PrettyUnitTestResultPrinter::OnTestIterationStart(
3460 const UnitTest& unit_test, int iteration) {
3461 if (GTEST_FLAG_GET(repeat) != 1)
3462 printf("\nRepeating all tests (iteration %d) . . .\n\n", iteration + 1);
3463
3464 std::string f = GTEST_FLAG_GET(filter);
3465 const char* const filter = f.c_str();
3466
3467 // Prints the filter if it's not *. This reminds the user that some
3468 // tests may be skipped.
3469 if (!String::CStringEquals(filter, kUniversalFilter)) {
3470 ColoredPrintf(GTestColor::kYellow, "Note: %s filter = %s\n", GTEST_NAME_,
3471 filter);
3472 }
3473
3474 if (internal::ShouldShard(kTestTotalShards, kTestShardIndex, false)) {
3475 const int32_t shard_index = Int32FromEnvOrDie(kTestShardIndex, -1);
3476 ColoredPrintf(GTestColor::kYellow, "Note: This is test shard %d of %s.\n",
3477 static_cast<int>(shard_index) + 1,
3478 internal::posix::GetEnv(kTestTotalShards));
3479 }
3480
3481 if (GTEST_FLAG_GET(shuffle)) {
3482 ColoredPrintf(GTestColor::kYellow,
3483 "Note: Randomizing tests' orders with a seed of %d .\n",
3484 unit_test.random_seed());
3485 }
3486
3487 ColoredPrintf(GTestColor::kGreen, "[==========] ");
3488 printf("Running %s from %s.\n",
3489 FormatTestCount(unit_test.test_to_run_count()).c_str(),
3490 FormatTestSuiteCount(unit_test.test_suite_to_run_count()).c_str());
3491 fflush(stdout);
3492}
3493
3494void PrettyUnitTestResultPrinter::OnEnvironmentsSetUpStart(
3495 const UnitTest& /*unit_test*/) {
3496 ColoredPrintf(GTestColor::kGreen, "[----------] ");
3497 printf("Global test environment set-up.\n");
3498 fflush(stdout);
3499}
3500
3501#ifndef GTEST_REMOVE_LEGACY_TEST_CASEAPI_
3502void PrettyUnitTestResultPrinter::OnTestCaseStart(const TestCase& test_case) {
3503 const std::string counts =
3504 FormatCountableNoun(test_case.test_to_run_count(), "test", "tests");
3505 ColoredPrintf(GTestColor::kGreen, "[----------] ");
3506 printf("%s from %s", counts.c_str(), test_case.name());
3507 if (test_case.type_param() == nullptr) {
3508 printf("\n");
3509 } else {
3510 printf(", where %s = %s\n", kTypeParamLabel, test_case.type_param());
3511 }
3512 fflush(stdout);
3513}
3514#else
3515void PrettyUnitTestResultPrinter::OnTestSuiteStart(
3516 const TestSuite& test_suite) {
3517 const std::string counts =
3518 FormatCountableNoun(test_suite.test_to_run_count(), "test", "tests");
3519 ColoredPrintf(GTestColor::kGreen, "[----------] ");
3520 printf("%s from %s", counts.c_str(), test_suite.name());
3521 if (test_suite.type_param() == nullptr) {
3522 printf("\n");
3523 } else {
3524 printf(", where %s = %s\n", kTypeParamLabel, test_suite.type_param());
3525 }
3526 fflush(stdout);
3527}
3528#endif // GTEST_REMOVE_LEGACY_TEST_CASEAPI_

3530void PrettyUnitTestResultPrinter::OnTestStart(const TestInfo& test_info) {

3537void PrettyUnitTestResultPrinter::OnTestDisabled(const TestInfo& test_info) {
3538 ColoredPrintf(GTestColor::kYellow, "[ DISABLED ] ");

3543
3544// Called after an assertion failure.
3545void PrettyUnitTestResultPrinter::OnTestPartResult(
3546 const TestPartResult& result) {
3547 switch (result.type()) {
3548 // If the test part succeeded, we don't need to do anything.
3549 case TestPartResult::kSuccess:
3550 return;
3551 default:
3552 // Print failure message from the assertion
3553 // (e.g. expected this and got that).
3554 PrintTestPartResult(result);
3555 fflush(stdout);
3556 }
3557}
3558
3559void PrettyUnitTestResultPrinter::OnTestEnd(const TestInfo& test_info) {
3560 if (test_info.result()->Passed()) {
3561 ColoredPrintf(GTestColor::kGreen, "[ OK ] ");
3562 } else if (test_info.result()->Skipped()) {
3563 ColoredPrintf(GTestColor::kGreen, "[ SKIPPED ] ");
3564 } else {
3565 ColoredPrintf(GTestColor::kRed, "[ FAILED ] ");
3566 }
3567 PrintTestName(test_info.test_suite_name(), test_info.name());
3568 if (test_info.result()->Failed()) PrintFullTestCommentIfPresent(test_info);
3569
3570 if (GTEST_FLAG_GET(print_time)) {
3571 printf(" (%s ms)\n",
3572 internal::StreamableToString(test_info.result()->elapsed_time())
3573 .c_str());
3574 } else {
3575 printf("\n");
3576 }
3577 fflush(stdout);
3578}
3579
3580#ifndef GTEST_REMOVE_LEGACY_TEST_CASEAPI_
3581void PrettyUnitTestResultPrinter::OnTestCaseEnd(const TestCase& test_case) {
3582 if (!GTEST_FLAG_GET(print_time)) return;
3583
3584 const std::string counts =
3585 FormatCountableNoun(test_case.test_to_run_count(), "test", "tests");
3586 ColoredPrintf(GTestColor::kGreen, "[----------] ");
3587 printf("%s from %s (%s ms total)\n\n", counts.c_str(), test_case.name(),
3588 internal::StreamableToString(test_case.elapsed_time()).c_str());
3589 fflush(stdout);
3590}
3591#else
3592void PrettyUnitTestResultPrinter::OnTestSuiteEnd(const TestSuite& test_suite) {
3593 if (!GTEST_FLAG_GET(print_time)) return;
3594
3595 const std::string counts =
3596 FormatCountableNoun(test_suite.test_to_run_count(), "test", "tests");
3597 ColoredPrintf(GTestColor::kGreen, "[----------] ");
3598 printf("%s from %s (%s ms total)\n\n", counts.c_str(), test_suite.name(),
3599 internal::StreamableToString(test_suite.elapsed_time()).c_str());
3600 fflush(stdout);
3601}
3602#endif // GTEST_REMOVE_LEGACY_TEST_CASEAPI_
3603
3604void PrettyUnitTestResultPrinter::OnEnvironmentsTearDownStart(
3605 const UnitTest& /*unit_test*/) {
3606 ColoredPrintf(GTestColor::kGreen, "[----------] ");
3607 printf("Global test environment tear-down\n");
3608 fflush(stdout);
3609}
3610
3611// Internal helper for printing the list of failed tests.
3612void PrettyUnitTestResultPrinter::PrintFailedTests(const UnitTest& unit_test) {
3613 const int failed_test_count = unit_test.failed_test_count();
3614 ColoredPrintf(GTestColor::kRed, "[ FAILED ] ");
3615 printf("%s, listed below:\n", FormatTestCount(failed_test_count).c_str());
3616
3617 for (int i = 0; i < unit_test.total_test_suite_count(); ++i) {
3618 const TestSuite& test_suite = *unit_test.GetTestSuite(i);
3619 if (!test_suite.should_run() || (test_suite.failed_test_count() == 0)) {
3620 continue;
3621 }
3622 for (int j = 0; j < test_suite.total_test_count(); ++j) {
3623 const TestInfo& test_info = *test_suite.GetTestInfo(j);
3624 if (!test_info.should_run() || !test_info.result()->Failed()) {
3625 continue;
3626 }
3627 ColoredPrintf(GTestColor::kRed, "[ FAILED ] ");
3628 printf("%s.%s", test_suite.name(), test_info.name());
3629 PrintFullTestCommentIfPresent(test_info);
3630 printf("\n");
3631 }
3632 }
3633 printf("\n%2d FAILED %s\n", failed_test_count,
3634 failed_test_count == 1 ? "TEST" : "TESTS");
3635}
3636
3637// Internal helper for printing the list of test suite failures not covered by
3638// PrintFailedTests.
3639void PrettyUnitTestResultPrinter::PrintFailedTestSuites(
3640 const UnitTest& unit_test) {
3641 int suite_failure_count = 0;
3642 for (int i = 0; i < unit_test.total_test_suite_count(); ++i) {
3643 const TestSuite& test_suite = *unit_test.GetTestSuite(i);
3644 if (!test_suite.should_run()) {
3645 continue;
3646 }
3647 if (test_suite.ad_hoc_test_result().Failed()) {
3648 ColoredPrintf(GTestColor::kRed, "[ FAILED ] ");
3649 printf("%s: SetUpTestSuite or TearDownTestSuite\n", test_suite.name());
3650 ++suite_failure_count;
3651 }
3652 }
3653 if (suite_failure_count > 0) {
3654 printf("\n%2d FAILED TEST %s\n", suite_failure_count,
3655 suite_failure_count == 1 ? "SUITE" : "SUITES");
3656 }
3657}
3658
3659// Internal helper for printing the list of skipped tests.
3660void PrettyUnitTestResultPrinter::PrintSkippedTests(const UnitTest& unit_test) {
3661 const int skipped_test_count = unit_test.skipped_test_count();
3662 if (skipped_test_count == 0) {
3663 return;
3664 }
3665
3666 for (int i = 0; i < unit_test.total_test_suite_count(); ++i) {
3667 const TestSuite& test_suite = *unit_test.GetTestSuite(i);
3668 if (!test_suite.should_run() || (test_suite.skipped_test_count() == 0)) {
3669 continue;
3670 }
3671 for (int j = 0; j < test_suite.total_test_count(); ++j) {
3672 const TestInfo& test_info = *test_suite.GetTestInfo(j);
3673 if (!test_info.should_run() || !test_info.result()->Skipped()) {
3674 continue;
3675 }
3676 ColoredPrintf(GTestColor::kGreen, "[ SKIPPED ] ");
3677 printf("%s.%s", test_suite.name(), test_info.name());
3678 printf("\n");
3679 }
3680 }
3681}
3682
3683void PrettyUnitTestResultPrinter::OnTestIterationEnd(const UnitTest& unit_test,
3684 int /*iteration*/) {
3685 ColoredPrintf(GTestColor::kGreen, "[==========] ");
3686 printf("%s from %s ran.",
3687 FormatTestCount(unit_test.test_to_run_count()).c_str(),
3688 FormatTestSuiteCount(unit_test.test_suite_to_run_count()).c_str());
3689 if (GTEST_FLAG_GET(print_time)) {
3690 printf(" (%s ms total)",
3691 internal::StreamableToString(unit_test.elapsed_time()).c_str());
3692 }
3693 printf("\n");
3694 ColoredPrintf(GTestColor::kGreen, "[ PASSED ] ");
3695 printf("%s.\n", FormatTestCount(unit_test.successful_test_count()).c_str());
3696
3697 const int skipped_test_count = unit_test.skipped_test_count();
3698 if (skipped_test_count > 0) {
3699 ColoredPrintf(GTestColor::kGreen, "[ SKIPPED ] ");
3700 printf("%s, listed below:\n", FormatTestCount(skipped_test_count).c_str());
3701 PrintSkippedTests(unit_test);
3702 }
3703
3704 if (!unit_test.Passed()) {
3705 PrintFailedTests(unit_test);
3706 PrintFailedTestSuites(unit_test);
3707 }
3708
3709 int num_disabled = unit_test.reportable_disabled_test_count();
3710 if (num_disabled && !GTEST_FLAG_GET(also_run_disabled_tests)) {
3711 if (unit_test.Passed()) {
3712 printf("\n"); // Add a spacer if no FAILURE banner is displayed.
3713 }
3714 ColoredPrintf(GTestColor::kYellow, " YOU HAVE %d DISABLED %s\n\n",
3715 num_disabled, num_disabled == 1 ? "TEST" : "TESTS");
3716 }
3717 // Ensure that Google Test output is printed before, e.g., heapchecker output.
3718 fflush(stdout);
3719}
3720
3721// End PrettyUnitTestResultPrinter

3762// Called after an assertion failure.
3763void BriefUnitTestResultPrinter::OnTestPartResult(
3764 const TestPartResult& result) {
3765 switch (result.type()) {
3766 // If the test part succeeded, we don't need to do anything.
3767 case TestPartResult::kSuccess:
3768 return;
3769 default:
3770 // Print failure message from the assertion
3771 // (e.g. expected this and got that).
3772 PrintTestPartResult(result);
3773 fflush(stdout);
3774 }

3783 if (GTEST_FLAG_GET(print_time)) {
3784 printf(" (%s ms)\n",
3785 internal::StreamableToString(test_info.result()->elapsed_time())
3786 .c_str());

3789 }

3828// class TestEventRepeater
3829//
3830// This class forwards events to other event listeners.
3831class TestEventRepeater : public TestEventListener {
3832 public:
3833 TestEventRepeater() : forwarding_enabled_(true) {}
3834 ~TestEventRepeater() override;
3835 void Append(TestEventListener* listener);
3836 TestEventListener* Release(TestEventListener* listener);
3837
3838 // Controls whether events will be forwarded to listeners_. Set to false
3839 // in death test child processes.
3840 bool forwarding_enabled() const { return forwarding_enabled_; }
3841 void set_forwarding_enabled(bool enable) { forwarding_enabled_ = enable; }
3842
3843 void OnTestProgramStart(const UnitTest& parameter) override;
3844 void OnTestIterationStart(const UnitTest& unit_test, int iteration) override;
3845 void OnEnvironmentsSetUpStart(const UnitTest& parameter) override;
3846 void OnEnvironmentsSetUpEnd(const UnitTest& parameter) override;
3847// Legacy API is deprecated but still available
3848#ifndef GTEST_REMOVE_LEGACY_TEST_CASEAPI_
3849 void OnTestCaseStart(const TestSuite& parameter) override;
3850#endif // GTEST_REMOVE_LEGACY_TEST_CASEAPI_
3851 void OnTestSuiteStart(const TestSuite& parameter) override;
3852 void OnTestStart(const TestInfo& parameter) override;
3853 void OnTestDisabled(const TestInfo& parameter) override;
3854 void OnTestPartResult(const TestPartResult& parameter) override;
3855 void OnTestEnd(const TestInfo& parameter) override;
3856// Legacy API is deprecated but still available
3857#ifndef GTEST_REMOVE_LEGACY_TEST_CASEAPI_
3858 void OnTestCaseEnd(const TestCase& parameter) override;
3859#endif // GTEST_REMOVE_LEGACY_TEST_CASEAPI_
3860 void OnTestSuiteEnd(const TestSuite& parameter) override;
3861 void OnEnvironmentsTearDownStart(const UnitTest& parameter) override;
3862 void OnEnvironmentsTearDownEnd(const UnitTest& parameter) override;
3863 void OnTestIterationEnd(const UnitTest& unit_test, int iteration) override;
3864 void OnTestProgramEnd(const UnitTest& parameter) override;
3865
3866 private:
3867 // Controls whether events will be forwarded to listeners_. Set to false
3868 // in death test child processes.
3869 bool forwarding_enabled_;
3870 // The list of listeners that receive events.
3871 std::vector<TestEventListener*> listeners_;
3872
3873 TestEventRepeater(const TestEventRepeater&) = delete;
3874 TestEventRepeater& operator=(const TestEventRepeater&) = delete;
3875};
3876
3877TestEventRepeater::~TestEventRepeater() {
3878 ForEach(listeners_, Delete<TestEventListener>);
3879}
3880
3881void TestEventRepeater::Append(TestEventListener* listener) {
3882 listeners_.push_back(listener);
3883}
3884
3885TestEventListener* TestEventRepeater::Release(TestEventListener* listener) {
3886 for (size_t i = 0; i < listeners_.size(); ++i) {
3887 if (listeners_[i] == listener) {
3888 listeners_.erase(listeners_.begin() + static_cast<int>(i));
3889 return listener;
3890 }
3891 }
3892
3893 return nullptr;
3894}
3895
3896// Since most methods are very similar, use macros to reduce boilerplate.
3897// This defines a member that forwards the call to all listeners.
3898#define GTEST_REPEATER_METHOD_(Name, Type) \
3899 void TestEventRepeater::Name(const Type& parameter) { \
3900 if (forwarding_enabled_) { \
3901 for (size_t i = 0; i < listeners_.size(); i++) { \
3902 listeners_[i]->Name(parameter); \
3903 } \
3904 } \
3905 }
3906// This defines a member that forwards the call to all listeners in reverse
3907// order.
3908#define GTEST_REVERSE_REPEATER_METHOD_(Name, Type) \
3909 void TestEventRepeater::Name(const Type& parameter) { \
3910 if (forwarding_enabled_) { \
3911 for (size_t i = listeners_.size(); i != 0; i--) { \
3912 listeners_[i - 1]->Name(parameter); \
3913 } \
3914 } \
3915 }
3916
3917GTEST_REPEATER_METHOD_(OnTestProgramStart, UnitTest)
3918GTEST_REPEATER_METHOD_(OnEnvironmentsSetUpStart, UnitTest)
3919// Legacy API is deprecated but still available
3920#ifndef GTEST_REMOVE_LEGACY_TEST_CASEAPI_
3921GTEST_REPEATER_METHOD_(OnTestCaseStart, TestSuite)
3922#endif // GTEST_REMOVE_LEGACY_TEST_CASEAPI_
3923GTEST_REPEATER_METHOD_(OnTestSuiteStart, TestSuite)
3924GTEST_REPEATER_METHOD_(OnTestStart, TestInfo)
3925GTEST_REPEATER_METHOD_(OnTestDisabled, TestInfo)
3926GTEST_REPEATER_METHOD_(OnTestPartResult, TestPartResult)
3927GTEST_REPEATER_METHOD_(OnEnvironmentsTearDownStart, UnitTest)
3928GTEST_REVERSE_REPEATER_METHOD_(OnEnvironmentsSetUpEnd, UnitTest)
3929GTEST_REVERSE_REPEATER_METHOD_(OnEnvironmentsTearDownEnd, UnitTest)
3930GTEST_REVERSE_REPEATER_METHOD_(OnTestEnd, TestInfo)
3931// Legacy API is deprecated but still available
3932#ifndef GTEST_REMOVE_LEGACY_TEST_CASEAPI_
3933GTEST_REVERSE_REPEATER_METHOD_(OnTestCaseEnd, TestSuite)
3934#endif // GTEST_REMOVE_LEGACY_TEST_CASEAPI_
3935GTEST_REVERSE_REPEATER_METHOD_(OnTestSuiteEnd, TestSuite)
3936GTEST_REVERSE_REPEATER_METHOD_(OnTestProgramEnd, UnitTest)
3937
3938#undef GTEST_REPEATER_METHOD_
3939#undef GTEST_REVERSE_REPEATER_METHOD_
3940
3941void TestEventRepeater::OnTestIterationStart(const UnitTest& unit_test,
3942 int iteration) {
3943 if (forwarding_enabled_) {
3944 for (size_t i = 0; i < listeners_.size(); i++) {
3945 listeners_[i]->OnTestIterationStart(unit_test, iteration);
3946 }
3947 }
3948}
3949
3950void TestEventRepeater::OnTestIterationEnd(const UnitTest& unit_test,
3951 int iteration) {
3952 if (forwarding_enabled_) {
3953 for (size_t i = listeners_.size(); i > 0; i--) {
3954 listeners_[i - 1]->OnTestIterationEnd(unit_test, iteration);
3955 }
3956 }
3957}
3958
3959// End TestEventRepeater

3961#if GTEST_HAS_FILE_SYSTEM
3962// This class generates an XML output file.
3963class XmlUnitTestResultPrinter : public EmptyTestEventListener {
3964 public:
3965 explicit XmlUnitTestResultPrinter(const char* output_file);
3966
3967 void OnTestIterationEnd(const UnitTest& unit_test, int iteration) override;
3968 void ListTestsMatchingFilter(const std::vector<TestSuite*>& test_suites);
3969
3970 // Prints an XML summary of all unit tests.
3971 static void PrintXmlTestsList(std::ostream* stream,
3972 const std::vector<TestSuite*>& test_suites);
3973
3974 private:
3975 // Is c a whitespace character that is normalized to a space character
3976 // when it appears in an XML attribute value?
3977 static bool IsNormalizableWhitespace(unsigned char c) {
3978 return c == '\t' || c == '\n' || c == '\r';
3979 }
3980
3981 // May c appear in a well-formed XML document?
3982 // https://www.w3.org/TR/REC-xml/#charsets
3983 static bool IsValidXmlCharacter(unsigned char c) {
3984 return IsNormalizableWhitespace(c) || c >= 0x20;
3985 }
3986
3987 // Returns an XML-escaped copy of the input string str. If
3988 // is_attribute is true, the text is meant to appear as an attribute
3989 // value, and normalizable whitespace is preserved by replacing it
3990 // with character references.
3991 static std::string EscapeXml(const std::string& str, bool is_attribute);
3992
3993 // Returns the given string with all characters invalid in XML removed.
3994 static std::string RemoveInvalidXmlCharacters(const std::string& str);
3995
3996 // Convenience wrapper around EscapeXml when str is an attribute value.
3997 static std::string EscapeXmlAttribute(const std::string& str) {
3998 return EscapeXml(str, true);
3999 }
4000
4001 // Convenience wrapper around EscapeXml when str is not an attribute value.
4002 static std::string EscapeXmlText(const char* str) {
4003 return EscapeXml(str, false);
4004 }
4005
4006 // Verifies that the given attribute belongs to the given element and
4007 // streams the attribute as XML.
4008 static void OutputXmlAttribute(std::ostream* stream,
4009 const std::string& element_name,
4010 const std::string& name,
4011 const std::string& value);
4012
4013 // Streams an XML CDATA section, escaping invalid CDATA sequences as needed.
4014 static void OutputXmlCDataSection(::std::ostream* stream, const char* data);
4015
4016 // Streams a test suite XML stanza containing the given test result.
4017 //
4018 // Requires: result.Failed()
4019 static void OutputXmlTestSuiteForTestResult(::std::ostream* stream,
4020 const TestResult& result);
4021
4022 // Streams a test case XML stanza containing the given test result.
4023 //
4024 // Requires: result.Failed()
4025 static void OutputXmlTestCaseForTestResult(::std::ostream* stream,
4026 const TestResult& result);
4027
4028 // Streams an XML representation of a TestResult object.
4029 static void OutputXmlTestResult(::std::ostream* stream,
4030 const TestResult& result);
4031
4032 // Streams an XML representation of a TestInfo object.
4033 static void OutputXmlTestInfo(::std::ostream* stream,
4034 const char* test_suite_name,
4035 const TestInfo& test_info);
4036
4037 // Prints an XML representation of a TestSuite object
4038 static void PrintXmlTestSuite(::std::ostream* stream,
4039 const TestSuite& test_suite);
4040
4041 // Prints an XML summary of unit_test to output stream out.
4042 static void PrintXmlUnitTest(::std::ostream* stream,
4043 const UnitTest& unit_test);
4044
4045 // Streams an XML representation of the test properties of a TestResult
4046 // object.
4047 static void OutputXmlTestProperties(std::ostream* stream,
4048 const TestResult& result,
4049 const std::string& indent);
4050
4051 // The output file.
4052 const std::string output_file_;
4053
4054 XmlUnitTestResultPrinter(const XmlUnitTestResultPrinter&) = delete;
4055 XmlUnitTestResultPrinter& operator=(const XmlUnitTestResultPrinter&) = delete;
4056};
4057
4058// Creates a new XmlUnitTestResultPrinter.
4059XmlUnitTestResultPrinter::XmlUnitTestResultPrinter(const char* output_file)
4060 : output_file_(output_file) {
4061 if (output_file_.empty()) {
4062 GTEST_LOG_(FATAL) << "XML output file may not be null";
4063 }
4064}
4065
4066// Called after the unit test ends.
4067void XmlUnitTestResultPrinter::OnTestIterationEnd(const UnitTest& unit_test,
4068 int /*iteration*/) {
4069 FILE* xmlout = OpenFileForWriting(output_file_);
4070 std::stringstream stream;
4071 PrintXmlUnitTest(&stream, unit_test);
4072 fprintf(xmlout, "%s", StringStreamToString(&stream).c_str());
4073 fclose(xmlout);
4074}
4075
4076void XmlUnitTestResultPrinter::ListTestsMatchingFilter(
4077 const std::vector<TestSuite*>& test_suites) {
4078 FILE* xmlout = OpenFileForWriting(output_file_);
4079 std::stringstream stream;
4080 PrintXmlTestsList(&stream, test_suites);
4081 fprintf(xmlout, "%s", StringStreamToString(&stream).c_str());
4082 fclose(xmlout);
4083}
4084
4085// Returns an XML-escaped copy of the input string str. If is_attribute
4086// is true, the text is meant to appear as an attribute value, and
4087// normalizable whitespace is preserved by replacing it with character
4088// references.
4089//
4090// Invalid XML characters in str, if any, are stripped from the output.
4091// It is expected that most, if not all, of the text processed by this
4092// module will consist of ordinary English text.
4093// If this module is ever modified to produce version 1.1 XML output,
4094// most invalid characters can be retained using character references.
4095std::string XmlUnitTestResultPrinter::EscapeXml(const std::string& str,
4096 bool is_attribute) {
4097 Message m;
4098
4099 for (size_t i = 0; i < str.size(); ++i) {
4100 const char ch = str[i];
4101 switch (ch) {
4102 case '<':
4103 m << "&lt;";
4104 break;
4105 case '>':
4106 m << "&gt;";
4107 break;
4108 case '&':
4109 m << "&amp;";
4110 break;
4111 case '\'':
4112 if (is_attribute)
4113 m << "&apos;";
4114 else
4115 m << '\'';
4116 break;
4117 case '"':
4118 if (is_attribute)
4119 m << "&quot;";
4120 else
4121 m << '"';
4122 break;
4123 default:
4124 if (IsValidXmlCharacter(static_cast<unsigned char>(ch))) {
4125 if (is_attribute &&
4126 IsNormalizableWhitespace(static_cast<unsigned char>(ch)))
4127 m << "&#x" << String::FormatByte(static_cast<unsigned char>(ch))
4128 << ";";
4129 else
4130 m << ch;
4131 }
4132 break;
4133 }
4134 }
4135
4136 return m.GetString();
4137}
4138
4139// Returns the given string with all characters invalid in XML removed.
4140// Currently invalid characters are dropped from the string. An
4141// alternative is to replace them with certain characters such as . or ?.
4142std::string XmlUnitTestResultPrinter::RemoveInvalidXmlCharacters(
4143 const std::string& str) {
4144 std::string output;
4145 output.reserve(str.size());
4146 for (std::string::const_iterator it = str.begin(); it != str.end(); ++it)
4147 if (IsValidXmlCharacter(static_cast<unsigned char>(*it)))
4148 output.push_back(*it);
4149
4150 return output;
4151}
4152
4153// The following routines generate an XML representation of a UnitTest
4154// object.
4155//
4156// This is how Google Test concepts map to the DTD:
4157//
4158// <testsuites name="AllTests"> <-- corresponds to a UnitTest object
4159// <testsuite name="testcase-name"> <-- corresponds to a TestSuite object
4160// <testcase name="test-name"> <-- corresponds to a TestInfo object
4161// <failure message="...">...</failure>
4162// <failure message="...">...</failure>
4163// <failure message="...">...</failure>
4164// <-- individual assertion failures
4165// </testcase>
4166// </testsuite>
4167// </testsuites>
4168
4169// Formats the given time in milliseconds as seconds.
4170std::string FormatTimeInMillisAsSeconds(TimeInMillis ms) {
4171 ::std::stringstream ss;
4172 // For the exact N seconds, makes sure output has a trailing decimal point.
4173 // Sets precision so that we won't have many trailing zeros (e.g., 300 ms
4174 // will be just 0.3, 410 ms 0.41, and so on)
4175 ss << std::fixed
4176 << std::setprecision(
4177 ms % 1000 == 0 ? 0 : (ms % 100 == 0 ? 1 : (ms % 10 == 0 ? 2 : 3)))
4178 << std::showpoint;
4179 ss << (static_cast<double>(ms) * 1e-3);
4180 return ss.str();
4181}
4182
4183static bool PortableLocaltime(time_t seconds, struct tm* out) {
4184#if defined(_MSC_VER)
4185 return localtime_s(out, &seconds) == 0;
4186#elif defined(__MINGW32__) || defined(__MINGW64__)
4187 // MINGW <time.h> provides neither localtime_r nor localtime_s, but uses
4188 // Windows' localtime(), which has a thread-local tm buffer.
4189 struct tm* tm_ptr = localtime(&seconds); // NOLINT
4190 if (tm_ptr == nullptr) return false;
4191 *out = *tm_ptr;
4192 return true;
4193#elif defined(__STDC_LIB_EXT1__)
4194 // Uses localtime_s when available as localtime_r is only available from
4195 // C23 standard.
4196 return localtime_s(&seconds, out) != nullptr;
4197#else
4198 return localtime_r(&seconds, out) != nullptr;
4199#endif
4200}
4201
4202// Converts the given epoch time in milliseconds to a date string in the ISO
4203// 8601 format, without the timezone information.
4204std::string FormatEpochTimeInMillisAsIso8601(TimeInMillis ms) {
4205 struct tm time_struct;
4206 if (!PortableLocaltime(static_cast<time_t>(ms / 1000), &time_struct))
4207 return "";
4208 // YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sss
4209 return StreamableToString(time_struct.tm_year + 1900) + "-" +
4210 String::FormatIntWidth2(time_struct.tm_mon + 1) + "-" +
4211 String::FormatIntWidth2(time_struct.tm_mday) + "T" +
4212 String::FormatIntWidth2(time_struct.tm_hour) + ":" +
4213 String::FormatIntWidth2(time_struct.tm_min) + ":" +
4214 String::FormatIntWidth2(time_struct.tm_sec) + "." +
4215 String::FormatIntWidthN(static_cast<int>(ms % 1000), 3);
4216}
4217
4218// Streams an XML CDATA section, escaping invalid CDATA sequences as needed.
4219void XmlUnitTestResultPrinter::OutputXmlCDataSection(::std::ostream* stream,
4220 const char* data) {
4221 const char* segment = data;
4222 *stream << "<![CDATA[";
4223 for (;;) {
4224 const char* const next_segment = strstr(segment, "]]>");
4225 if (next_segment != nullptr) {
4226 stream->write(segment,
4227 static_cast<std::streamsize>(next_segment - segment));
4228 *stream << "]]>]]&gt;<![CDATA[";
4229 segment = next_segment + strlen("]]>");
4230 } else {
4231 *stream << segment;
4232 break;
4233 }
4234 }
4235 *stream << "]]>";
4236}
4237
4238void XmlUnitTestResultPrinter::OutputXmlAttribute(
4239 std::ostream* stream, const std::string& element_name,
4240 const std::string& name, const std::string& value) {
4241 const std::vector<std::string>& allowed_names =
4242 GetReservedOutputAttributesForElement(element_name);
4243
4244 GTEST_CHECK_(std::find(allowed_names.begin(), allowed_names.end(), name) !=
4245 allowed_names.end())
4246 << "Attribute " << name << " is not allowed for element <" << element_name
4247 << ">.";
4248
4249 *stream << " " << name << "=\"" << EscapeXmlAttribute(value) << "\"";
4250}
4251
4252// Streams a test suite XML stanza containing the given test result.
4253void XmlUnitTestResultPrinter::OutputXmlTestSuiteForTestResult(
4254 ::std::ostream* stream, const TestResult& result) {
4255 // Output the boilerplate for a minimal test suite with one test.
4256 *stream << " <testsuite";
4257 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, "testsuite", "name", "NonTestSuiteFailure");
4258 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, "testsuite", "tests", "1");
4259 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, "testsuite", "failures", "1");
4260 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, "testsuite", "disabled", "0");
4261 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, "testsuite", "skipped", "0");
4262 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, "testsuite", "errors", "0");
4263 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, "testsuite", "time",
4264 FormatTimeInMillisAsSeconds(result.elapsed_time()));
4265 OutputXmlAttribute(
4266 stream, "testsuite", "timestamp",
4267 FormatEpochTimeInMillisAsIso8601(result.start_timestamp()));
4268 *stream << ">";
4269
4270 OutputXmlTestCaseForTestResult(stream, result);
4271
4272 // Complete the test suite.
4273 *stream << " </testsuite>\n";
4274}
4275
4276// Streams a test case XML stanza containing the given test result.
4277void XmlUnitTestResultPrinter::OutputXmlTestCaseForTestResult(
4278 ::std::ostream* stream, const TestResult& result) {
4279 // Output the boilerplate for a minimal test case with a single test.
4280 *stream << " <testcase";
4281 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, "testcase", "name", "");
4282 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, "testcase", "status", "run");
4283 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, "testcase", "result", "completed");
4284 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, "testcase", "classname", "");
4285 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, "testcase", "time",
4286 FormatTimeInMillisAsSeconds(result.elapsed_time()));
4287 OutputXmlAttribute(
4288 stream, "testcase", "timestamp",
4289 FormatEpochTimeInMillisAsIso8601(result.start_timestamp()));
4290
4291 // Output the actual test result.
4292 OutputXmlTestResult(stream, result);
4293}
4294
4295// Prints an XML representation of a TestInfo object.
4296void XmlUnitTestResultPrinter::OutputXmlTestInfo(::std::ostream* stream,
4297 const char* test_suite_name,
4298 const TestInfo& test_info) {
4299 const TestResult& result = *test_info.result();
4300 const std::string kTestsuite = "testcase";
4301
4302 if (test_info.is_in_another_shard()) {
4303 return;
4304 }
4305
4306 *stream << " <testcase";
4307 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, kTestsuite, "name", test_info.name());
4308
4309 if (test_info.value_param() != nullptr) {
4310 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, kTestsuite, "value_param",
4311 test_info.value_param());
4312 }
4313 if (test_info.type_param() != nullptr) {
4314 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, kTestsuite, "type_param",
4315 test_info.type_param());
4316 }
4317
4318 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, kTestsuite, "file", test_info.file());
4319 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, kTestsuite, "line",
4320 StreamableToString(test_info.line()));
4321 if (GTEST_FLAG_GET(list_tests)) {
4322 *stream << " />\n";
4323 return;
4324 }
4325
4326 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, kTestsuite, "status",
4327 test_info.should_run() ? "run" : "notrun");
4328 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, kTestsuite, "result",
4329 test_info.should_run()
4330 ? (result.Skipped() ? "skipped" : "completed")
4331 : "suppressed");
4332 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, kTestsuite, "time",
4333 FormatTimeInMillisAsSeconds(result.elapsed_time()));
4334 OutputXmlAttribute(
4335 stream, kTestsuite, "timestamp",
4336 FormatEpochTimeInMillisAsIso8601(result.start_timestamp()));
4337 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, kTestsuite, "classname", test_suite_name);
4338
4339 OutputXmlTestResult(stream, result);
4340}
4341
4342void XmlUnitTestResultPrinter::OutputXmlTestResult(::std::ostream* stream,
4343 const TestResult& result) {
4344 int failures = 0;
4345 int skips = 0;
4346 for (int i = 0; i < result.total_part_count(); ++i) {
4347 const TestPartResult& part = result.GetTestPartResult(i);
4348 if (part.failed()) {
4349 if (++failures == 1 && skips == 0) {
4350 *stream << ">\n";
4351 }
4352 const std::string location =
4353 internal::FormatCompilerIndependentFileLocation(part.file_name(),
4354 part.line_number());
4355 const std::string summary = location + "\n" + part.summary();
4356 *stream << " <failure message=\"" << EscapeXmlAttribute(summary)
4357 << "\" type=\"\">";
4358 const std::string detail = location + "\n" + part.message();
4359 OutputXmlCDataSection(stream, RemoveInvalidXmlCharacters(detail).c_str());
4360 *stream << "</failure>\n";
4361 } else if (part.skipped()) {
4362 if (++skips == 1 && failures == 0) {
4363 *stream << ">\n";
4364 }
4365 const std::string location =
4366 internal::FormatCompilerIndependentFileLocation(part.file_name(),
4367 part.line_number());
4368 const std::string summary = location + "\n" + part.summary();
4369 *stream << " <skipped message=\"" << EscapeXmlAttribute(summary)
4370 << "\">";
4371 const std::string detail = location + "\n" + part.message();
4372 OutputXmlCDataSection(stream, RemoveInvalidXmlCharacters(detail).c_str());
4373 *stream << "</skipped>\n";
4374 }
4375 }
4376
4377 if (failures == 0 && skips == 0 && result.test_property_count() == 0) {
4378 *stream << " />\n";
4379 } else {
4380 if (failures == 0 && skips == 0) {
4381 *stream << ">\n";
4382 }
4383 OutputXmlTestProperties(stream, result, /*indent=*/" ");
4384 *stream << " </testcase>\n";
4385 }
4386}
4387
4388// Prints an XML representation of a TestSuite object
4389void XmlUnitTestResultPrinter::PrintXmlTestSuite(std::ostream* stream,
4390 const TestSuite& test_suite) {
4391 const std::string kTestsuite = "testsuite";
4392 *stream << " <" << kTestsuite;
4393 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, kTestsuite, "name", test_suite.name());
4394 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, kTestsuite, "tests",
4395 StreamableToString(test_suite.reportable_test_count()));
4396 if (!GTEST_FLAG_GET(list_tests)) {
4397 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, kTestsuite, "failures",
4398 StreamableToString(test_suite.failed_test_count()));
4399 OutputXmlAttribute(
4400 stream, kTestsuite, "disabled",
4401 StreamableToString(test_suite.reportable_disabled_test_count()));
4402 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, kTestsuite, "skipped",
4403 StreamableToString(test_suite.skipped_test_count()));
4404
4405 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, kTestsuite, "errors", "0");
4406
4407 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, kTestsuite, "time",
4408 FormatTimeInMillisAsSeconds(test_suite.elapsed_time()));
4409 OutputXmlAttribute(
4410 stream, kTestsuite, "timestamp",
4411 FormatEpochTimeInMillisAsIso8601(test_suite.start_timestamp()));
4412 }
4413 *stream << ">\n";
4414 OutputXmlTestProperties(stream, test_suite.ad_hoc_test_result(),
4415 /*indent=*/" ");
4416 for (int i = 0; i < test_suite.total_test_count(); ++i) {
4417 if (test_suite.GetTestInfo(i)->is_reportable())
4418 OutputXmlTestInfo(stream, test_suite.name(), *test_suite.GetTestInfo(i));
4419 }
4420 if (test_suite.ad_hoc_test_result().Failed()) {
4421 OutputXmlTestCaseForTestResult(stream, test_suite.ad_hoc_test_result());
4422 }
4423
4424 *stream << " </" << kTestsuite << ">\n";
4425}
4426
4427// Prints an XML summary of unit_test to output stream out.
4428void XmlUnitTestResultPrinter::PrintXmlUnitTest(std::ostream* stream,
4429 const UnitTest& unit_test) {
4430 const std::string kTestsuites = "testsuites";
4431
4432 *stream << "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>\n";
4433 *stream << "<" << kTestsuites;
4434
4435 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, kTestsuites, "tests",
4436 StreamableToString(unit_test.reportable_test_count()));
4437 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, kTestsuites, "failures",
4438 StreamableToString(unit_test.failed_test_count()));
4439 OutputXmlAttribute(
4440 stream, kTestsuites, "disabled",
4441 StreamableToString(unit_test.reportable_disabled_test_count()));
4442 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, kTestsuites, "errors", "0");
4443 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, kTestsuites, "time",
4444 FormatTimeInMillisAsSeconds(unit_test.elapsed_time()));
4445 OutputXmlAttribute(
4446 stream, kTestsuites, "timestamp",
4447 FormatEpochTimeInMillisAsIso8601(unit_test.start_timestamp()));
4448
4449 if (GTEST_FLAG_GET(shuffle)) {
4450 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, kTestsuites, "random_seed",
4451 StreamableToString(unit_test.random_seed()));
4452 }
4453
4454 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, kTestsuites, "name", "AllTests");
4455 *stream << ">\n";
4456
4457 OutputXmlTestProperties(stream, unit_test.ad_hoc_test_result(),
4458 /*indent=*/" ");
4459 for (int i = 0; i < unit_test.total_test_suite_count(); ++i) {
4460 if (unit_test.GetTestSuite(i)->reportable_test_count() > 0)
4461 PrintXmlTestSuite(stream, *unit_test.GetTestSuite(i));
4462 }
4463
4464 // If there was a test failure outside of one of the test suites (like in a
4465 // test environment) include that in the output.
4466 if (unit_test.ad_hoc_test_result().Failed()) {
4467 OutputXmlTestSuiteForTestResult(stream, unit_test.ad_hoc_test_result());
4468 }
4469
4470 *stream << "</" << kTestsuites << ">\n";
4471}
4472
4473void XmlUnitTestResultPrinter::PrintXmlTestsList(
4474 std::ostream* stream, const std::vector<TestSuite*>& test_suites) {
4475 const std::string kTestsuites = "testsuites";
4476
4477 *stream << "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>\n";
4478 *stream << "<" << kTestsuites;
4479
4480 int total_tests = 0;
4481 for (auto test_suite : test_suites) {
4482 total_tests += test_suite->total_test_count();
4483 }
4484 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, kTestsuites, "tests",
4485 StreamableToString(total_tests));
4486 OutputXmlAttribute(stream, kTestsuites, "name", "AllTests");
4487 *stream << ">\n";
4488
4489 for (auto test_suite : test_suites) {
4490 PrintXmlTestSuite(stream, *test_suite);
4491 }
4492 *stream << "</" << kTestsuites << ">\n";
4493}
4494
4495void XmlUnitTestResultPrinter::OutputXmlTestProperties(
4496 std::ostream* stream, const TestResult& result, const std::string& indent) {
4497 const std::string kProperties = "properties";
4498 const std::string kProperty = "property";
4499
4500 if (result.test_property_count() <= 0) {
4501 return;
4502 }
4503
4504 *stream << indent << "<" << kProperties << ">\n";
4505 for (int i = 0; i < result.test_property_count(); ++i) {
4506 const TestProperty& property = result.GetTestProperty(i);
4507 *stream << indent << " <" << kProperty;
4508 *stream << " name=\"" << EscapeXmlAttribute(property.key()) << "\"";
4509 *stream << " value=\"" << EscapeXmlAttribute(property.value()) << "\"";
4510 *stream << "/>\n";
4511 }
4512 *stream << indent << "</" << kProperties << ">\n";
4513}

4515// End XmlUnitTestResultPrinter
4516#endif // GTEST_HAS_FILE_SYSTEM

4518#if GTEST_HAS_FILE_SYSTEM
4519// This class generates an JSON output file.
4520class JsonUnitTestResultPrinter : public EmptyTestEventListener {
4521 public:
4522 explicit JsonUnitTestResultPrinter(const char* output_file);
4523
4524 void OnTestIterationEnd(const UnitTest& unit_test, int iteration) override;
4525
4526 // Prints an JSON summary of all unit tests.
4527 static void PrintJsonTestList(::std::ostream* stream,
4528 const std::vector<TestSuite*>& test_suites);
4529
4530 private:
4531 // Returns an JSON-escaped copy of the input string str.
4532 static std::string EscapeJson(const std::string& str);
4533
4536 static void OutputJsonKey(std::ostream* stream,
4537 const std::string& element_name,
4538 const std::string& name, const std::string& value,
4539 const std::string& indent, bool comma = true);
4540 static void OutputJsonKey(std::ostream* stream,
4541 const std::string& element_name,
4542 const std::string& name, int value,
4543 const std::string& indent, bool comma = true);
4544
4545 // Streams a test suite JSON stanza containing the given test result.
4546 //
4547 // Requires: result.Failed()
4548 static void OutputJsonTestSuiteForTestResult(::std::ostream* stream,
4549 const TestResult& result);
4550
4551 // Streams a test case JSON stanza containing the given test result.
4552 //
4553 // Requires: result.Failed()
4554 static void OutputJsonTestCaseForTestResult(::std::ostream* stream,
4555 const TestResult& result);
4556
4557 // Streams a JSON representation of a TestResult object.
4558 static void OutputJsonTestResult(::std::ostream* stream,
4559 const TestResult& result);
4560
4561 // Streams a JSON representation of a TestInfo object.
4562 static void OutputJsonTestInfo(::std::ostream* stream,
4563 const char* test_suite_name,
4564 const TestInfo& test_info);
4565
4566 // Prints a JSON representation of a TestSuite object
4567 static void PrintJsonTestSuite(::std::ostream* stream,
4568 const TestSuite& test_suite);
4569
4570 // Prints a JSON summary of unit_test to output stream out.
4571 static void PrintJsonUnitTest(::std::ostream* stream,
4572 const UnitTest& unit_test);
4573
4574 // Produces a string representing the test properties in a result as
4575 // a JSON dictionary.
4576 static std::string TestPropertiesAsJson(const TestResult& result,
4577 const std::string& indent);
4578
4579 // The output file.
4580 const std::string output_file_;
4581
4582 JsonUnitTestResultPrinter(const JsonUnitTestResultPrinter&) = delete;
4583 JsonUnitTestResultPrinter& operator=(const JsonUnitTestResultPrinter&) =
4584 delete;
4585};
4586
4587// Creates a new JsonUnitTestResultPrinter.
4588JsonUnitTestResultPrinter::JsonUnitTestResultPrinter(const char* output_file)
4589 : output_file_(output_file) {
4590 if (output_file_.empty()) {
4591 GTEST_LOG_(FATAL) << "JSON output file may not be null";
4592 }
4593}
4594
4595void JsonUnitTestResultPrinter::OnTestIterationEnd(const UnitTest& unit_test,
4596 int /*iteration*/) {
4597 FILE* jsonout = OpenFileForWriting(output_file_);
4598 std::stringstream stream;
4599 PrintJsonUnitTest(&stream, unit_test);
4600 fprintf(jsonout, "%s", StringStreamToString(&stream).c_str());
4601 fclose(jsonout);
4602}
4603
4604// Returns an JSON-escaped copy of the input string str.
4605std::string JsonUnitTestResultPrinter::EscapeJson(const std::string& str) {
4606 Message m;
4607
4608 for (size_t i = 0; i < str.size(); ++i) {
4609 const char ch = str[i];
4610 switch (ch) {
4611 case '\\':
4612 case '"':
4613 case '/':
4614 m << '\\' << ch;
4615 break;
4616 case '\b':
4617 m << "\\b";
4618 break;
4619 case '\t':
4620 m << "\\t";
4621 break;
4622 case '\n':
4623 m << "\\n";
4624 break;
4625 case '\f':
4626 m << "\\f";
4627 break;
4628 case '\r':
4629 m << "\\r";
4630 break;
4631 default:
4632 if (ch < ' ') {
4633 m << "\\u00" << String::FormatByte(static_cast<unsigned char>(ch));
4634 } else {
4635 m << ch;
4636 }
4637 break;
4638 }
4639 }
4640
4641 return m.GetString();
4642}
4643
4644// The following routines generate an JSON representation of a UnitTest
4645// object.
4646
4647// Formats the given time in milliseconds as seconds.
4648static std::string FormatTimeInMillisAsDuration(TimeInMillis ms) {
4649 ::std::stringstream ss;
4650 ss << (static_cast<double>(ms) * 1e-3) << "s";
4651 return ss.str();
4652}
4653
4654// Converts the given epoch time in milliseconds to a date string in the
4655// RFC3339 format, without the timezone information.
4656static std::string FormatEpochTimeInMillisAsRFC3339(TimeInMillis ms) {
4657 struct tm time_struct;
4658 if (!PortableLocaltime(static_cast<time_t>(ms / 1000), &time_struct))
4659 return "";
4660 // YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss
4661 return StreamableToString(time_struct.tm_year + 1900) + "-" +
4662 String::FormatIntWidth2(time_struct.tm_mon + 1) + "-" +
4663 String::FormatIntWidth2(time_struct.tm_mday) + "T" +
4664 String::FormatIntWidth2(time_struct.tm_hour) + ":" +
4665 String::FormatIntWidth2(time_struct.tm_min) + ":" +
4666 String::FormatIntWidth2(time_struct.tm_sec) + "Z";
4667}
4668
4669static inline std::string Indent(size_t width) {
4670 return std::string(width, ' ');
4671}
4672
4673void JsonUnitTestResultPrinter::OutputJsonKey(std::ostream* stream,
4674 const std::string& element_name,
4675 const std::string& name,
4676 const std::string& value,
4677 const std::string& indent,
4678 bool comma) {
4679 const std::vector<std::string>& allowed_names =
4680 GetReservedOutputAttributesForElement(element_name);
4681
4682 GTEST_CHECK_(std::find(allowed_names.begin(), allowed_names.end(), name) !=
4683 allowed_names.end())
4684 << "Key \"" << name << "\" is not allowed for value \"" << element_name
4685 << "\".";
4686
4687 *stream << indent << "\"" << name << "\": \"" << EscapeJson(value) << "\"";
4688 if (comma) *stream << ",\n";
4689}
4690
4691void JsonUnitTestResultPrinter::OutputJsonKey(
4692 std::ostream* stream, const std::string& element_name,
4693 const std::string& name, int value, const std::string& indent, bool comma) {
4694 const std::vector<std::string>& allowed_names =
4695 GetReservedOutputAttributesForElement(element_name);
4696
4697 GTEST_CHECK_(std::find(allowed_names.begin(), allowed_names.end(), name) !=
4698 allowed_names.end())
4699 << "Key \"" << name << "\" is not allowed for value \"" << element_name
4700 << "\".";
4701
4702 *stream << indent << "\"" << name << "\": " << StreamableToString(value);
4703 if (comma) *stream << ",\n";
4704}
4705
4706// Streams a test suite JSON stanza containing the given test result.
4707void JsonUnitTestResultPrinter::OutputJsonTestSuiteForTestResult(
4708 ::std::ostream* stream, const TestResult& result) {
4709 // Output the boilerplate for a new test suite.
4710 *stream << Indent(4) << "{\n";
4711 OutputJsonKey(stream, "testsuite", "name", "NonTestSuiteFailure", Indent(6));
4712 OutputJsonKey(stream, "testsuite", "tests", 1, Indent(6));
4713 if (!GTEST_FLAG_GET(list_tests)) {
4714 OutputJsonKey(stream, "testsuite", "failures", 1, Indent(6));
4715 OutputJsonKey(stream, "testsuite", "disabled", 0, Indent(6));
4716 OutputJsonKey(stream, "testsuite", "skipped", 0, Indent(6));
4717 OutputJsonKey(stream, "testsuite", "errors", 0, Indent(6));
4718 OutputJsonKey(stream, "testsuite", "time",
4719 FormatTimeInMillisAsDuration(result.elapsed_time()),
4720 Indent(6));
4721 OutputJsonKey(stream, "testsuite", "timestamp",
4722 FormatEpochTimeInMillisAsRFC3339(result.start_timestamp()),
4723 Indent(6));
4724 }
4725 *stream << Indent(6) << "\"testsuite\": [\n";
4726
4727 OutputJsonTestCaseForTestResult(stream, result);
4728
4729 // Finish the test suite.
4730 *stream << "\n" << Indent(6) << "]\n" << Indent(4) << "}";
4731}
4732
4733// Streams a test case JSON stanza containing the given test result.
4734void JsonUnitTestResultPrinter::OutputJsonTestCaseForTestResult(
4735 ::std::ostream* stream, const TestResult& result) {
4736 // Output the boilerplate for a new test case.
4737 *stream << Indent(8) << "{\n";
4738 OutputJsonKey(stream, "testcase", "name", "", Indent(10));
4739 OutputJsonKey(stream, "testcase", "status", "RUN", Indent(10));
4740 OutputJsonKey(stream, "testcase", "result", "COMPLETED", Indent(10));
4741 OutputJsonKey(stream, "testcase", "timestamp",
4742 FormatEpochTimeInMillisAsRFC3339(result.start_timestamp()),
4743 Indent(10));
4744 OutputJsonKey(stream, "testcase", "time",
4745 FormatTimeInMillisAsDuration(result.elapsed_time()),
4746 Indent(10));
4747 OutputJsonKey(stream, "testcase", "classname", "", Indent(10), false);
4748 *stream << TestPropertiesAsJson(result, Indent(10));
4749
4750 // Output the actual test result.
4751 OutputJsonTestResult(stream, result);
4752}
4753
4754// Prints a JSON representation of a TestInfo object.
4755void JsonUnitTestResultPrinter::OutputJsonTestInfo(::std::ostream* stream,
4756 const char* test_suite_name,
4757 const TestInfo& test_info) {
4758 const TestResult& result = *test_info.result();
4759 const std::string kTestsuite = "testcase";
4760 const std::string kIndent = Indent(10);
4761
4762 *stream << Indent(8) << "{\n";
4763 OutputJsonKey(stream, kTestsuite, "name", test_info.name(), kIndent);
4764
4765 if (test_info.value_param() != nullptr) {
4766 OutputJsonKey(stream, kTestsuite, "value_param", test_info.value_param(),
4767 kIndent);
4768 }
4769 if (test_info.type_param() != nullptr) {
4770 OutputJsonKey(stream, kTestsuite, "type_param", test_info.type_param(),
4771 kIndent);
4772 }
4773
4774 OutputJsonKey(stream, kTestsuite, "file", test_info.file(), kIndent);
4775 OutputJsonKey(stream, kTestsuite, "line", test_info.line(), kIndent, false);
4776 if (GTEST_FLAG_GET(list_tests)) {
4777 *stream << "\n" << Indent(8) << "}";
4778 return;
4779 } else {
4780 *stream << ",\n";
4781 }
4782
4783 OutputJsonKey(stream, kTestsuite, "status",
4784 test_info.should_run() ? "RUN" : "NOTRUN", kIndent);
4785 OutputJsonKey(stream, kTestsuite, "result",
4786 test_info.should_run()
4787 ? (result.Skipped() ? "SKIPPED" : "COMPLETED")
4788 : "SUPPRESSED",
4789 kIndent);
4790 OutputJsonKey(stream, kTestsuite, "timestamp",
4791 FormatEpochTimeInMillisAsRFC3339(result.start_timestamp()),
4792 kIndent);
4793 OutputJsonKey(stream, kTestsuite, "time",
4794 FormatTimeInMillisAsDuration(result.elapsed_time()), kIndent);
4795 OutputJsonKey(stream, kTestsuite, "classname", test_suite_name, kIndent,
4796 false);
4797 *stream << TestPropertiesAsJson(result, kIndent);
4798
4799 OutputJsonTestResult(stream, result);
4800}
4801
4802void JsonUnitTestResultPrinter::OutputJsonTestResult(::std::ostream* stream,
4803 const TestResult& result) {
4804 const std::string kIndent = Indent(10);
4805
4806 {
4807 int failures = 0;
4808 for (int i = 0; i < result.total_part_count(); ++i) {
4809 const TestPartResult& part = result.GetTestPartResult(i);
4810 if (part.failed()) {
4811 *stream << ",\n";
4812 if (++failures == 1) {
4813 *stream << kIndent << "\"" << "failures" << "\": [\n";
4814 }
4815 const std::string location =
4816 internal::FormatCompilerIndependentFileLocation(part.file_name(),
4817 part.line_number());
4818 const std::string message =
4819 EscapeJson(location + "\n" + part.message());
4820 *stream << kIndent << " {\n"
4821 << kIndent << " \"failure\": \"" << message << "\",\n"
4822 << kIndent << " \"type\": \"\"\n"
4823 << kIndent << " }";
4824 }
4825 }
4826
4827 if (failures > 0) *stream << "\n" << kIndent << "]";
4828 }
4829
4830 {
4831 int skipped = 0;
4832 for (int i = 0; i < result.total_part_count(); ++i) {
4833 const TestPartResult& part = result.GetTestPartResult(i);
4834 if (part.skipped()) {
4835 *stream << ",\n";
4836 if (++skipped == 1) {
4837 *stream << kIndent << "\"" << "skipped" << "\": [\n";
4838 }
4839 const std::string location =
4840 internal::FormatCompilerIndependentFileLocation(part.file_name(),
4841 part.line_number());
4842 const std::string message =
4843 EscapeJson(location + "\n" + part.message());
4844 *stream << kIndent << " {\n"
4845 << kIndent << " \"message\": \"" << message << "\"\n"
4846 << kIndent << " }";
4847 }
4848 }
4849
4850 if (skipped > 0) *stream << "\n" << kIndent << "]";
4851 }
4852
4853 *stream << "\n" << Indent(8) << "}";
4854}
4855
4856// Prints an JSON representation of a TestSuite object
4857void JsonUnitTestResultPrinter::PrintJsonTestSuite(
4858 std::ostream* stream, const TestSuite& test_suite) {
4859 const std::string kTestsuite = "testsuite";
4860 const std::string kIndent = Indent(6);
4861
4862 *stream << Indent(4) << "{\n";
4863 OutputJsonKey(stream, kTestsuite, "name", test_suite.name(), kIndent);
4864 OutputJsonKey(stream, kTestsuite, "tests", test_suite.reportable_test_count(),
4865 kIndent);
4866 if (!GTEST_FLAG_GET(list_tests)) {
4867 OutputJsonKey(stream, kTestsuite, "failures",
4868 test_suite.failed_test_count(), kIndent);
4869 OutputJsonKey(stream, kTestsuite, "disabled",
4870 test_suite.reportable_disabled_test_count(), kIndent);
4871 OutputJsonKey(stream, kTestsuite, "errors", 0, kIndent);
4872 OutputJsonKey(
4873 stream, kTestsuite, "timestamp",
4874 FormatEpochTimeInMillisAsRFC3339(test_suite.start_timestamp()),
4875 kIndent);
4876 OutputJsonKey(stream, kTestsuite, "time",
4877 FormatTimeInMillisAsDuration(test_suite.elapsed_time()),
4878 kIndent, false);
4879 *stream << TestPropertiesAsJson(test_suite.ad_hoc_test_result(), kIndent)
4880 << ",\n";
4881 }
4882
4883 *stream << kIndent << "\"" << kTestsuite << "\": [\n";
4884
4885 bool comma = false;
4886 for (int i = 0; i < test_suite.total_test_count(); ++i) {
4887 if (test_suite.GetTestInfo(i)->is_reportable()) {
4888 if (comma) {
4889 *stream << ",\n";
4890 } else {
4891 comma = true;
4892 }
4893 OutputJsonTestInfo(stream, test_suite.name(), *test_suite.GetTestInfo(i));
4894 }
4895 }
4896
4897 // If there was a failure in the test suite setup or teardown include that in
4898 // the output.
4899 if (test_suite.ad_hoc_test_result().Failed()) {
4900 if (comma) {
4901 *stream << ",\n";
4902 }
4903 OutputJsonTestCaseForTestResult(stream, test_suite.ad_hoc_test_result());
4904 }
4905
4906 *stream << "\n" << kIndent << "]\n" << Indent(4) << "}";
4907}
4908
4909// Prints a JSON summary of unit_test to output stream out.
4910void JsonUnitTestResultPrinter::PrintJsonUnitTest(std::ostream* stream,
4911 const UnitTest& unit_test) {
4912 const std::string kTestsuites = "testsuites";
4913 const std::string kIndent = Indent(2);
4914 *stream << "{\n";
4915
4916 OutputJsonKey(stream, kTestsuites, "tests", unit_test.reportable_test_count(),
4917 kIndent);
4918 OutputJsonKey(stream, kTestsuites, "failures", unit_test.failed_test_count(),
4919 kIndent);
4920 OutputJsonKey(stream, kTestsuites, "disabled",
4921 unit_test.reportable_disabled_test_count(), kIndent);
4922 OutputJsonKey(stream, kTestsuites, "errors", 0, kIndent);
4923 if (GTEST_FLAG_GET(shuffle)) {
4924 OutputJsonKey(stream, kTestsuites, "random_seed", unit_test.random_seed(),
4925 kIndent);
4926 }
4927 OutputJsonKey(stream, kTestsuites, "timestamp",
4928 FormatEpochTimeInMillisAsRFC3339(unit_test.start_timestamp()),
4929 kIndent);
4930 OutputJsonKey(stream, kTestsuites, "time",
4931 FormatTimeInMillisAsDuration(unit_test.elapsed_time()), kIndent,
4932 false);
4933
4934 *stream << TestPropertiesAsJson(unit_test.ad_hoc_test_result(), kIndent)
4935 << ",\n";
4936
4937 OutputJsonKey(stream, kTestsuites, "name", "AllTests", kIndent);
4938 *stream << kIndent << "\"" << kTestsuites << "\": [\n";
4939
4940 bool comma = false;
4941 for (int i = 0; i < unit_test.total_test_suite_count(); ++i) {
4942 if (unit_test.GetTestSuite(i)->reportable_test_count() > 0) {
4943 if (comma) {
4944 *stream << ",\n";
4945 } else {
4946 comma = true;
4947 }
4948 PrintJsonTestSuite(stream, *unit_test.GetTestSuite(i));
4949 }
4950 }
4951
4952 // If there was a test failure outside of one of the test suites (like in a
4953 // test environment) include that in the output.
4954 if (unit_test.ad_hoc_test_result().Failed()) {
4955 if (comma) {
4956 *stream << ",\n";
4957 }
4958 OutputJsonTestSuiteForTestResult(stream, unit_test.ad_hoc_test_result());
4959 }
4960
4961 *stream << "\n"
4962 << kIndent << "]\n"
4963 << "}\n";
4964}
4965
4966void JsonUnitTestResultPrinter::PrintJsonTestList(
4967 std::ostream* stream, const std::vector<TestSuite*>& test_suites) {
4968 const std::string kTestsuites = "testsuites";
4969 const std::string kIndent = Indent(2);
4970 *stream << "{\n";
4971 int total_tests = 0;
4972 for (auto test_suite : test_suites) {
4973 total_tests += test_suite->total_test_count();
4974 }
4975 OutputJsonKey(stream, kTestsuites, "tests", total_tests, kIndent);
4976
4977 OutputJsonKey(stream, kTestsuites, "name", "AllTests", kIndent);
4978 *stream << kIndent << "\"" << kTestsuites << "\": [\n";
4979
4980 for (size_t i = 0; i < test_suites.size(); ++i) {
4981 if (i != 0) {
4982 *stream << ",\n";
4983 }
4984 PrintJsonTestSuite(stream, *test_suites[i]);
4985 }
4986
4987 *stream << "\n"
4988 << kIndent << "]\n"
4989 << "}\n";
4990}
4991// Produces a string representing the test properties in a result as
4992// a JSON dictionary.
4993std::string JsonUnitTestResultPrinter::TestPropertiesAsJson(
4994 const TestResult& result, const std::string& indent) {
4995 Message attributes;
4996 for (int i = 0; i < result.test_property_count(); ++i) {
4997 const TestProperty& property = result.GetTestProperty(i);
4998 attributes << ",\n"
4999 << indent << "\"" << property.key() << "\": " << "\""
5000 << EscapeJson(property.value()) << "\"";
5001 }
5002 return attributes.GetString();
5003}

5008#if GTEST_CAN_STREAM_RESULTS_
5009
5010// Checks if str contains '=', '&', '%' or '\n' characters. If yes,
5011// replaces them by "%xx" where xx is their hexadecimal value. For
5012// example, replaces "=" with "%3D". This algorithm is O(strlen(str))
5013// in both time and space -- important as the input str may contain an
5014// arbitrarily long test failure message and stack trace.
5015std::string StreamingListener::UrlEncode(const char* str) {
5016 std::string result;
5017 result.reserve(strlen(str) + 1);
5018 for (char ch = *str; ch != '\0'; ch = *++str) {
5019 switch (ch) {
5020 case '%':
5021 case '=':
5022 case '&':
5023 case '\n':
5024 result.push_back('%');
5025 result.append(String::FormatByte(static_cast<unsigned char>(ch)));
5026 break;
5027 default:
5028 result.push_back(ch);
5029 break;
5030 }
5031 }
5032 return result;
5033}
5034
5035void StreamingListener::SocketWriter::MakeConnection() {
5036 GTEST_CHECK_(sockfd_ == -1)
5037 << "MakeConnection() can't be called when there is already a connection.";
5038
5039 addrinfo hints;
5040 memset(&hints, 0, sizeof(hints));
5041 hints.ai_family = AF_UNSPEC; // To allow both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.
5042 hints.ai_socktype = SOCK_STREAM;
5043 addrinfo* servinfo = nullptr;
5044
5045 // Use the getaddrinfo() to get a linked list of IP addresses for
5046 // the given host name.
5047 const int error_num =
5048 getaddrinfo(host_name_.c_str(), port_num_.c_str(), &hints, &servinfo);
5049 if (error_num != 0) {
5050 GTEST_LOG_(WARNING) << "stream_result_to: getaddrinfo() failed: "
5051 << gai_strerror(error_num);
5052 }
5053
5054 // Loop through all the results and connect to the first we can.
5055 for (addrinfo* cur_addr = servinfo; sockfd_ == -1 && cur_addr != nullptr;
5056 cur_addr = cur_addr->ai_next) {
5057 sockfd_ = socket(cur_addr->ai_family, cur_addr->ai_socktype,
5058 cur_addr->ai_protocol);
5059 if (sockfd_ != -1) {
5060 // Connect the client socket to the server socket.
5061 if (connect(sockfd_, cur_addr->ai_addr, cur_addr->ai_addrlen) == -1) {
5062 close(sockfd_);
5063 sockfd_ = -1;
5064 }
5065 }
5066 }
5067
5068 freeaddrinfo(servinfo); // all done with this structure
5069
5070 if (sockfd_ == -1) {
5071 GTEST_LOG_(WARNING) << "stream_result_to: failed to connect to "
5072 << host_name_ << ":" << port_num_;
5073 }
5074}
5075
5076// End of class Streaming Listener
5077#endif // GTEST_CAN_STREAM_RESULTS__
5078
5079// class OsStackTraceGetter
5080
5081const char* const OsStackTraceGetterInterface::kElidedFramesMarker =
5082 "... " GTEST_NAME_ " internal frames ...";
5083
5084std::string OsStackTraceGetter::CurrentStackTrace(int max_depth, int skip_count)
5085 GTEST_LOCK_EXCLUDED_(mutex_) {
5086#ifdef GTEST_HAS_ABSL
5087 std::string result;
5088
5089 if (max_depth <= 0) {
5090 return result;
5091 }
5092
5093 max_depth = std::min(max_depth, kMaxStackTraceDepth);
5094
5095 std::vector<void*> raw_stack(max_depth);
5096 // Skips the frames requested by the caller, plus this function.
5097 const int raw_stack_size =
5098 absl::GetStackTrace(&raw_stack[0], max_depth, skip_count + 1);
5099
5100 void* caller_frame = nullptr;
5101 {
5102 MutexLock lock(mutex_);
5103 caller_frame = caller_frame_;
5104 }
5105
5106 for (int i = 0; i < raw_stack_size; ++i) {
5107 if (raw_stack[i] == caller_frame &&
5108 !GTEST_FLAG_GET(show_internal_stack_frames)) {
5109 // Add a marker to the trace and stop adding frames.
5110 absl::StrAppend(&result, kElidedFramesMarker, "\n");
5111 break;
5112 }
5113
5114 char tmp[1024];
5115 const char* symbol = "(unknown)";
5116 if (absl::Symbolize(raw_stack[i], tmp, sizeof(tmp))) {
5117 symbol = tmp;
5118 }
5119
5120 char line[1024];
5121 snprintf(line, sizeof(line), " %p: %s\n", raw_stack[i], symbol);
5122 result += line;
5123 }
5124
5125 return result;
5126
5127#else // !GTEST_HAS_ABSL
5128 static_cast<void>(max_depth);
5129 static_cast<void>(skip_count);
5130 return "";
5131#endif // GTEST_HAS_ABSL
5132}
5133
5134void OsStackTraceGetter::UponLeavingGTest() GTEST_LOCK_EXCLUDED_(mutex_) {
5135#ifdef GTEST_HAS_ABSL
5136 void* caller_frame = nullptr;
5137 if (absl::GetStackTrace(&caller_frame, 1, 3) <= 0) {
5138 caller_frame = nullptr;
5139 }
5140
5141 MutexLock lock(mutex_);
5142 caller_frame_ = caller_frame;
5143#endif // GTEST_HAS_ABSL
5144}

5146#ifdef GTEST_INTERNAL_HAS_PREMATURE_EXIT_FILE
5147// A helper class that creates the premature-exit file in its
5148// constructor and deletes the file in its destructor.
5149class ScopedPrematureExitFile {
5150 public:
5151 explicit ScopedPrematureExitFile(const char* premature_exit_filepath)
5152 : premature_exit_filepath_(
5153 premature_exit_filepath ? premature_exit_filepath : "") {
5154 // If a path to the premature-exit file is specified...
5155 if (!premature_exit_filepath_.empty()) {
5156 // create the file with a single "0" character in it. I/O
5157 // errors are ignored as there's nothing better we can do and we
5158 // don't want to fail the test because of this.
5159 FILE* pfile = posix::FOpen(premature_exit_filepath_.c_str(), "w");
5160 fwrite("0", 1, 1, pfile);
5161 fclose(pfile);
5162 }
5163 }
5164
5165 ~ScopedPrematureExitFile() {
5166#ifndef GTEST_OS_ESP8266
5167 if (!premature_exit_filepath_.empty()) {
5168 int retval = remove(premature_exit_filepath_.c_str());
5169 if (retval) {
5170 GTEST_LOG_(ERROR) << "Failed to remove premature exit filepath \""
5171 << premature_exit_filepath_ << "\" with error "
5172 << retval;
5173 }
5174 }
5175#endif
5176 }
5177
5178 private:
5179 const std::string premature_exit_filepath_;
5180
5181 ScopedPrematureExitFile(const ScopedPrematureExitFile&) = delete;
5182 ScopedPrematureExitFile& operator=(const ScopedPrematureExitFile&) = delete;
5183};
5184#endif // GTEST_INTERNAL_HAS_PREMATURE_EXIT_FILE

5205// Removes the given event listener from the list and returns it. It then
5206// becomes the caller's responsibility to delete the listener. Returns
5207// NULL if the listener is not found in the list.
5208TestEventListener* TestEventListeners::Release(TestEventListener* listener) {
5209 if (listener == default_result_printer_)

5220// Sets the default_result_printer attribute to the provided listener.
5221// The listener is also added to the listener list and previous
5222// default_result_printer is removed from it and deleted. The listener can
5223// also be NULL in which case it will not be added to the list. Does
5224// nothing if the previous and the current listener objects are the same.
5225void TestEventListeners::SetDefaultResultPrinter(TestEventListener* listener) {
5226 if (default_result_printer_ != listener) {
5227 // It is an error to pass this method a listener that is already in the
5228 // list.
5229 delete Release(default_result_printer_);
5230 default_result_printer_ = listener;
5231 if (listener != nullptr) Append(listener);
5232 }
5233}

5235// Sets the default_xml_generator attribute to the provided listener. The
5236// listener is also added to the listener list and previous
5237// default_xml_generator is removed from it and deleted. The listener can
5238// also be NULL in which case it will not be added to the list. Does
5239// nothing if the previous and the current listener objects are the same.
5240void TestEventListeners::SetDefaultXmlGenerator(TestEventListener* listener) {
5241 if (default_xml_generator_ != listener) {
5242 // It is an error to pass this method a listener that is already in the
5243 // list.
5244 delete Release(default_xml_generator_);
5245 default_xml_generator_ = listener;
5246 if (listener != nullptr) Append(listener);
5247 }

5436
5437// Adds a TestPartResult to the current TestResult object. All Google Test
5438// assertion macros (e.g. ASSERT_TRUE, EXPECT_EQ, etc) eventually call
5439// this to report their results. The user code should use the
5440// assertion macros instead of calling this directly.
5441void UnitTest::AddTestPartResult(TestPartResult::Type result_type,
5442 const std::string_view file_name,
5443 int line_number, const std::string& message,
5444 const std::string& os_stack_trace)
5445 GTEST_LOCK_EXCLUDED_(mutex_) {
5446 Message msg;
5447 msg << message;
5448
5449 internal::MutexLock lock(mutex_);
5450 if (!impl_->gtest_trace_stack().empty()) {
5451 msg << "\n" << GTEST_NAME_ << " trace:";
5452
5453 for (size_t i = impl_->gtest_trace_stack().size(); i > 0; --i) {
5454 const internal::TraceInfo& trace = impl_->gtest_trace_stack()[i - 1];
5455 msg << "\n"
5456 << internal::FormatFileLocation(trace.file, trace.line) << " "
5457 << trace.message;
5458 }
5459 }
5460
5461 if (os_stack_trace.c_str() != nullptr && !os_stack_trace.empty()) {
5462 msg << internal::kStackTraceMarker << os_stack_trace;
5463 } else {
5464 msg << "\n";
5465 }
5466
5467 const TestPartResult result = TestPartResult(
5468 result_type, file_name, line_number, msg.GetString().c_str());
5469 impl_->GetTestPartResultReporterForCurrentThread()->ReportTestPartResult(
5470 result);
5471
5472 if (result_type != TestPartResult::kSuccess &&
5473 result_type != TestPartResult::kSkip) {
5474 // gtest_break_on_failure takes precedence over
5475 // gtest_throw_on_failure. This allows a user to set the latter
5476 // in the code (perhaps in order to use Google Test assertions
5477 // with another testing framework) and specify the former on the
5478 // command line for debugging.
5479 if (GTEST_FLAG_GET(break_on_failure)) {
5480#if defined(GTEST_OS_WINDOWS) && !defined(GTEST_OS_WINDOWS_PHONE) && \
5481 !defined(GTEST_OS_WINDOWS_RT)
5482 // Using DebugBreak on Windows allows gtest to still break into a debugger
5483 // when a failure happens and both the --gtest_break_on_failure and
5484 // the --gtest_catch_exceptions flags are specified.
5485 DebugBreak();
5486#elif (!defined(__native_client__)) && \
5487 ((defined(__clang__) || defined(__GNUC__)) && \
5488 (defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)))
5489 // with clang/gcc we can achieve the same effect on x86 by invoking int3
5490 asm("int3");
5491#elif GTEST_HAS_BUILTIN(__builtin_trap)
5492 __builtin_trap();
5493#elif defined(SIGTRAP)
5494 raise(SIGTRAP);
5495#else
5496 // Dereference nullptr through a volatile pointer to prevent the compiler
5497 // from removing. We use this rather than abort() or __builtin_trap() for
5498 // portability: some debuggers don't correctly trap abort().
5499 *static_cast<volatile int*>(nullptr) = 1;
5500#endif // GTEST_OS_WINDOWS
5501 } else if (GTEST_FLAG_GET(throw_on_failure)) {
5502#if GTEST_HAS_EXCEPTIONS
5503 throw internal::GoogleTestFailureException(result);
5504#else
5505 // We cannot call abort() as it generates a pop-up in debug mode
5506 // that cannot be suppressed in VC 7.1 or below.
5507 exit(1);
5508#endif
5509 }
5510 }
5511}

5513// Adds a TestProperty to the current TestResult object when invoked from
5514// inside a test, to current TestSuite's ad_hoc_test_result_ when invoked
5515// from SetUpTestSuite or TearDownTestSuite, or to the global property set
5516// when invoked elsewhere. If the result already contains a property with
5517// the same key, the value will be updated.
5518void UnitTest::RecordProperty(const std::string& key,
5519 const std::string& value) {
5520 impl_->RecordProperty(TestProperty(key, value));
